# Correct auto-generated transcript text in Firefly video editor

Speech recognition creates the automatic transcript, so pronunciation, phrasing, or audio quality can sometimes cause missed words or phrases. Firefly video editor includes Correct transcript so the text can be cleaned up, matched to the dialogue, and kept understandable.

Before you begin:

Start a new project, then place a dialogue video file on the timeline.

Select the Text-based editing icon in the right panel.

Search for the transcript text you need to fix, or preview the video with Auto-scrolling enabled in the Text-based editing panel.

To fix part of the transcript, select the text and choose the Correct transcript icon from the context menu.

Correct transcript lets you add or repair words and phrases that the transcript missed.

Use Correct transcript to fix missing transcript words or phrases.

After editing, choose Correct all to replace every matching instance in the transcript with the corrected text.

Correct all applies the selected correction to all matching transcript occurrences.

Use Correct all when the same selected text should be updated everywhere in the transcript.
